scripts.build:mobile: set CAPACITOR=true && tsc && vite build && npx cap sync
scripts.mobile:android: npm run build:mobile && npx cap open android
scripts.mobile:ios: npm run build:mobile && npx cap open ios
scripts.android:apk: npm run build:mobile && cd android && gradlew.bat assembleDebug
scripts.eas:build: npm run build:mobile && npx eas build -p android --profile preview
scripts.eas:build:prod: npm run build:mobile && npx eas build -p android --profile production
